text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, at Nice Nature's request, she 
was training together with Win Variation.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Your routine is pretty tough, Nature-san. 
Then again, I guess you gotta be able to 
breeze through this much.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
To beat an overwhelming genius like that 
flashy golden jerk...! I gotta give it 
everything I've got...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Exactly that. Hard work is the 
only way. Well then, shall we do one more 
set?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Two kindred spirits, both striving to 
challenge a genius. And after a friendly 
training session together...

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the food!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Man, that was a lot of running. Good work, 
everyone~

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Thank you for your hard work. I 
really learned a lot! Thanks so much for 
today.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's what matters most. Oh, 
mister~, another order of gyoza and 
pickled mustard greens! And a Carrot Cider 
too~!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Guhh! That girl...! Always acting so 
nonchalant right ahead of me...! What do I 
have to do to catch up to her...?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I totally get it...! When they shine that 
brightly, you know? The gap just wouldn't 
close at all—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
—Totally, you're so right. Phew~~~... It's 
been so long... since I was able to say 
stuff like this out loud.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm sorry...! Even though you're here 
with me, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, venting is important. I mean, it's 
not easy to talk about, right? Feelings 
like these.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I want to beat a genius"... It's like, 
when there's such a huge gap in our skill 
and talent, I was too embarrassed, too 
scared to ever say it out loud.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Still, we're taking this totally seriously 
too, aren't we...? Right, Shion-san?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm totally serious. I just really 
feel a lot of sympathy for Nature-san.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
“Still, she's a way more amazing Umamusume 
than me, ssr...”

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Nature-san, even when you have trouble 
winning, you never ever give up on trying, 
do you?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Even in today's training, both the volume 
and intensity were off the charts! I can 
totally tell you haven't given up one bit!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
No matter what happens down the road, I 
want to stay unbroken just like that, 
too...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
It totally makes sense why she has so many 
fans. I mean, I'm a huge fan of Nature-san 
myself!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"When you say it so directly to my face, 
it's kind of embarrassing, or rather..."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Because that's how I truly feel. I'm 
rooting for you...!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, yes, yes! Understood! Thank you very 
much!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Duuude... how about that? Look at that 
dead-serious face on Sion-san.
choice_data_list:
They're really cheering for you with all 
their heart!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'm grateful for it, for sure~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if even someone like me is 
reaching people's hearts a little bit...?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm sure it's not just her.
Yeah, I'm sure she's not the only one.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it is precisely because she is 
like this that so many fans want to cheer 
for her. Her refusal to give up moves 
countless hearts.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, am I supposed to be happy about 
that~? Not like I'm the main character 
type anyway."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Still, I get why people would go 'Whoa!' 
if someone like me won.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: And above all... I want to see it myself.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I've got no choice but to give it my all, 
right? Not after being cheered on so 
earnestly like that!
